page.overview:
Who is Gerudo Warrior?

The appears in the after Link, defeats all of the four to rescue the Carpenters. While is away at the , she leaves this Gerudo in charge of the , making her technically the third-in-command of the Gerudo race, behind Nabooru and Ganondorf himself.

After Link frees all the Carpenters, the appears to compliment him on accomplishing such a task and rewards him with the , which allows the Hero of Time to walk about freely in the and access the without the risk of being arrested.
